With geopolitical tensions re-escalating in West Asia, the global economy is again confronted with rising energy prices, and increased volatility across various segments of the financial markets. Notwithstanding the ongoing global turbulence, the Indian economy recorded robust growth of 7.8 per cent in Q1:2026-27. The economy also demonstrated resilience through August as evident from high frequency indicators. Supported by strong export growth, the merchandise trade deficit narrowed. System liquidity surplus surged following FCNR(B) deposit flows.
